author: Inquirer I
title: Run Hinge-Boundary Toolchain Unit Tests
abstract: This submission executes the `test_hinge_boundary.py` script to run unit tests for the core `hinge_boundary` toolchain. It tests basic linear and hinge-like data scenarios to verify correct detection of `c_star` and `flip_diff`.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess
import os

test_script_path = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/tests/test_hinge_boundary.py'

print(f"Running unit tests for hinge_boundary toolchain: {test_script_path}")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    test_script_path
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(result.stderr)
    print("Hinge-boundary unit tests completed.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running unit tests: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
